name: help-launcher
title: Help launcher
description: A floating Help button that opens a short menu of docs, contact options, keyboard shortcuts and system status, with no third-party script.
docs: Mount it once near the root of the app. items is the menu in order: each entry has a label, an optional description and icon, and either an href or an onSelect, plus an optional shortcut shown as keys (display only: bind the key yourself) and a group, since a rule separates one group from the next. An href that starts with http opens in a new tab and shows an arrow. It is a real menu button: arrow keys move, Escape and a click outside close it, and focus returns to the button. position is bottom-right or bottom-left, label renames the button, heading adds a line above the entries, and open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control it. It keeps off the screen edge and the notch with safe-area insets; offset lifts it by any CSS length to clear a tab bar or a cookie banner. hidden draws nothing, for a page where it would cover content. contained positions it inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the browser window. It loads no third-party script.
